posts.t: Spencer Knight sends Brady Tkachuk hard into the boards with a trip, and Tkachuk is none too pleased about it.

Has there been a better Both Sides End Up Very Happy trade in recent years than the Seth Jones trade?

– Jones got out.
– Hawks got out from under Jones' contract.
– Panthers won a Cup with Jones playing a huge role. 
– Hawks got a bona-fide No. 1 goalie in Spencer Knight.
Spencer Knight coming off the ice for another forward with 3:10 left.
Ohhh Spencer Knight took Danault's skate in the mask.

NEW POWERS & LAZ: @marklazerus.bsky.social and I discuss Blackhawks' roster construction, Spencer Knight's season, Kevin Korchinski's situation, the recent games and more.
